steps.label: The camp of God
steps.copy: The angels of God meet him. “This is the camp of God,” he says, and names the place Mahanaim.

steps.label: Wrestling till dawn
steps.copy: By the Jabbok a man wrestles with Jacob until daybreak and renames him Israel.

steps.label: Face to face with Esau
steps.copy: Esau runs to meet him, embraces him, and they weep.

steps.label: Succoth
steps.copy: Jacob builds a house for himself and shelters for his livestock.

steps.label: On to Shechem
steps.copy: He comes safely to the city of Shechem and sets up an altar.

steps.label: The 300 at the spring
steps.copy: God keeps only the three hundred men who lapped the water and sends the rest home.

steps.label: Torches and trumpets
steps.copy: At night the 300 blow trumpets and smash their jars, and the Midianite camp turns on itself and flees.

steps.label: Seizing the waters
steps.copy: The men of Ephraim take the waters as far as the Jordan and capture the commanders Oreb and Zeeb.

steps.label: Faint yet pursuing
steps.copy: Gideon's 300 cross the Jordan, exhausted, but the officials of Succoth refuse them bread.

steps.label: Penuel refuses too
steps.copy: The men of Penuel give the same answer.

steps.label: Overtaking at Karkor
steps.copy: He surprises the camp and captures the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna.
